author: high3
claim: Solved direct affine proof: compute the unique intersection P=AD∩BE and characterize P∈CF.
evidence: Write q=1-s+st. Solving (1-λ)A+λ((1-t)B+tC)=μ(sA+(1-s)C)+(1-μ)B gives λ=(1-s)/q and μ=t/q, hence P=(st/q)A+((1-s)(1-t)/q)B+(t(1-s)/q)C. The three coefficients are positive and sum to 1. A point with coefficients α,β,γ lies on CF, where F=(1-u)A+uB, exactly when β/α=u/(1-u): necessity follows by writing the point as νF+(1-ν)C; sufficiency follows by setting ν=α+β. Here β/α=(1-s)(1-t)/(st). Therefore P∈CF iff [t/(1-t)][s/(1-s)][u/(1-u)]=1, which is exactly the target ratio condition.

links.subgoal: Prove both directions of the target theorem by one affine intersection computation.
links.attempt_summary: All subgoals solved; the intersection and third-line condition are explicit.
